contentItem.title: 圆的弦：两端都落在圆周上的线段
contentItem.englishTitle: A straight line is said to be fitted into a circle when its extremities are on the circumference of the circle.

revision.changeSummary: Imported Heath source and machine-assisted Chinese draft. No mathematical or editorial review is implied.

surfaces.text: A straight line is said to be fitted into a circle when its extremities are on the circumference of the circle.
据说,当圆周圆周围是直线时,则直线将安装在一个圆上。（相关点与线段：A）
